messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — vendor just confirmed a staggered shipment: 10 H100s delayed by 6-10 days. This directly affects reservations for cluster-dedicated wave B (next-week canary). I pushed an updated allocation spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/gpu-slate (see ‘wave-B ripple’ tab). Can owners call out blockers?
kevin: Ugh. Thanks for flagging. Which racks are affected? If it's the east eu site we can maybe swap with the spare ops pool.
sam: The spreadsheet maps affected racks -> reservations. Looks like 3 racks in eu-west, 2 in us-west. If we move reservations we'll need a network VLAN config change and a reassign PR for the allocation service.
jordan: I can take the VLAN changes for the two us-west racks, but I need the rack IDs and the spare capacity lease numbers. Also need an ETA from procurement for confirmed ship dates.
maria: Rack IDs in the sheet (cols F-H). Procurement update: vendor email pinned in the sheet comments — tentative ship 6/14 earliest, 6/18 latest. They said partial shipment is possible but not guaranteed.
kevin: Partial would help. We should prepare fallback routing policy: if reserved capacity drops below 80% for canary, route canary to dedicated-staging with lower SLO but keep observability. Who owns policy? @jordan?
jordan: I own routing rules. I'll draft a temporary policy: prefer spare-pool, fallback dedicated-staging, last-resort hosted-api. Will post PR.
sam: FYI the allocation service will reject changes that overlap with existing reservations. Here's the command I used to preview reassignments locally:
```
./allocctl preview --from-resv 2026-06-B --to-pool spare-ops --dry-run
```
maria: Nice. If we do reassignments we must also notify customers with affected commitments (enterprise contracts). Legal/sales pinged separately, but product ops needs the final list. Can owners compile a single CSV of customer-impact rows?
kevin: I'll export reservation rows and tag with owner. Will drop in the sheet and add a small notes column.
jordan: PR for routing policy: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/8321 — draft includes a metric trigger (reserved_util < 0.8). Can reviewers please take a look? :eyes:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary alert policy created by jordan. Rule ID infra/canary-fallback-2026-06 created.
sam: Also a heads-up for eng-sre — can we queue a maintenance window for the reassigned racks? Reprovisioning will require 45m per rack (network, bios, whitelisting).
maria: Good call. Eng-sre, can we schedule 6/12 afternoon windows for us-west racks if procurement confirms partial shipment? If delayed, we'll push to 6/19.
kevin: I'll coordinate with procurement for exact manifest; pushing to the vendor contact now.
jordan: I'll add a short playbook in the PR describing steps and who runs them. Link to playbook in the PR description.
maria: Action items recap: 1) kevin: export customer-impact CSV into sheet (due EOD), 2) jordan: finalize routing PR and playbook (ASAP), 3) sam: test allocctl reassignment dry-run and post logs (by EOD), 4) eng-sre: tentative maintenance window (standby). If anything slips, ping #incidents.
kevin: Got it. I'll post the CSV and tag sales/legal.
sam: Running dry-run now, will paste output below when done.
maria: Thanks all — will update exec sync after we have firm vendor ETA. :thumbsup:
